## Prior art

- [doi:10.37236/41](https://doi.org/10.37236/41) (Theorem 1), checked 2026-10-21: Theorem 1 (Erdos-Hajnal-Moon 1964, doi:10.2307/2311408): sat(n,K\_p) = (p-2)(n-p+2) + C(p-2,2), which gives 2n-3 for p = 4.
